objects.name: Analytic 2126
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a firmware update utility on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux engineering host initiating a connection to a device Internet Protocol (IP) address on its firmware update port, by a User Identifier (UID) not in the approved firmware manager UIDs, outside a scheduled maintenance window. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
